nodes.label: Accordion Content Block Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: 16x16 SVG icon representing the accordion content block. Design shows a white outer rectangle with a grey border (full panel outline), three horizontal grey lines at the top suggesting collapsed/closed rows, and a blue/highlight rectangle in the lower-right quadrant containing a small white image/thumbnail placeholder (mountain-like shapes and a circle indicating a photo). Three shorter grey lines on the left side of the lower half suggest list items or text rows. Overall the icon visually communicates an accordion UI element with expandable/collapsible sections containing mixed content (text + image).
